name: Human Punishment: Social Deduction 2.0
summary: Hidden-team social deduction where humans, machines and outlaws try to eliminate each other with weapons and programs.
rules_text: Each player gets a face-down ID and two loyalty cards, plus one hidden program. Team is majority color of IDs/loyalties: blue Human, red Machine, gray Outlaw; some cards count double or say Always X. Special IDs Mindeater creates Legion, Deathbringer creates Fallen. Everyone has 2 HP. On your turn become active player: either investigate another player's one loyalty (or ID if loyalties shown), equip a weapon from the center and aim it at a target, or draw a program. If you start turn holding a weapon you may instead drop it, retarget, or shoot. Pistol/companion/rocket force target to reveal a loyalty or take 1 damage; rifle/laser forces ID reveal or 2 damage. Programs are hidden and limited to two at end of turn, some change loyalty secretly. When HP hits 0 you are out, reveal your cards, and check win: if all opposing teams are gone your team wins; if no Human at start, last player alive wins. Weapons cannot target eliminated players.
